body.heading: Where in the world is Spain?
paragraphs: Spain is a country in Southern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Spain is Madrid.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Spain is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Spain is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Spain?
paragraphs: Spain covers about 506,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of United Kingdom.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Barcelona sparkles with Gaudí's imagination: the still-growing Sagrada Família basilica, the mosaic dragon of Park Güell and the wavy Casa Batlló.
The Alhambra is a palace-city of the Nasrid sultans — carved stucco, tile mosaics and garden courtyards beneath the snowy Sierra Nevada.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Spain on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
